pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Moscow Variation, Moscow Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e4-e5 when White's e-pawn has been taken and called Bg5 a pin (the e7-pawn shields the queen). Rewrote plan 1 (reviewer: first draft kept the pin).
